repo_model.summary: This repository is a RelBench generic-search workspace whose root candidate loads a configured task and writes validation/test predictions for recommendation, classification, or regression tasks. The Kapso helper and evaluation modules define the data-loading, prediction-file, validation-scoring, rolling-run, and archiving contracts.

entrypoints.how_to_run: python main.py --debug for the fast/debug run, or python main.py for the full run

where_to_edit.role: Required candidate entrypoint; replace the seeded trivial prediction logic with the real solution
Optional contract helpers for loading RelBench data, checking temporal safety, evaluating MAP@K, and saving predictions
Read-only local validator for prediction shapes, dtypes, finiteness, and binary ranges
Immutable official scoring and archiving pipeline; do not implement candidate behavior here

claims.statement: The root candidate is environment-driven: it reads the RelBench dataset/task, loads the task with downloads disabled, determines validation/test row counts, and detects rolling ticks from the validation cache.

evidence.description: Documents empty validation tables in rolling snapshots
Checks the configured cache for val.parquet

claims.statement: Prediction generation dispatches by task family: recommendations receive ranked integer IDs, binary classification receives 0.5 probabilities, multiclass classification receives uniform class scores, and other tasks receive the training-target median.

evidence.description: Uses the training target for other task types

claims.statement: The starter helpers provide a TaskContext containing the dataset, task, database, and train/validation/test tables, plus a save_predictions helper that writes both required NumPy artifacts.

evidence.description: Loads train, validation, and test tables
Writes validation and test prediction files

claims.statement: The immutable grader runs main.py in an isolated child process, loads the official validation table, validates predictions, computes RelBench validation metrics, and archives full-fidelity runs.
When rolling evaluation is enabled, the grader invokes the candidate once per cache snapshot and reconstructs each split's full prediction vector using snapshot indices.

evidence.description: Creates a per-tick cache and output directory
Runs the candidate for each snapshot

claims.statement: Every normal candidate run must write val_predictions.npy and test_predictions.npy with rows positionally aligned to the official validation and test tables; validation predictions must be out-of-sample and must not be trained on validation labels.

evidence.description: Requires both prediction files after every run
Requires save_predictions in every run mode

claims.statement: Prediction formats are task-specific: binary and regression use float vectors of shape (N,), multiclass uses float scores of shape (N,C), and recommendation uses integer rankings of shape (N,K) containing distinct destination IDs.

evidence.description: Defines binary and regression output formats

claims.statement: Data must be read through the RelBench API with download=False from the sanitized read-only cache; test labels are absent and must not be probed for.

evidence.description: Requires download=False and read-only cache access
States that test labels are physically absent
Documents loading from the sanitized cache

claims.statement: The search score is the official validation primary metric; test metrics are private, and the manifest records the untransformed validation score.

evidence.description: Defines the score of record as the manifest score
Says metric direction is handled by search
States test predictions cannot be scored in the loop
Stores the primary validation metric as score

claims.statement: Feature rows must not occur after their seed timestamp; assert_temporal_safety raises a temporal-leak error when any row violates this condition.

evidence.description: Detects rows after the seed time

claims.statement: A fast dry run executes main.py with --debug, still scores the complete official validation split, and is the recommended pipeline sanity check before a full run.

evidence.description: States that validation rows are not subsampled

claims.statement: After writing predictions, run python kapso_datasets/check_predictions.py to catch missing files, shape errors, non-finite values, invalid binary ranges, and recommendation dtype problems before official scoring.

evidence.description: Checks both validation and test splits

claims.statement: A successful official evaluation prints OFFICIAL VALIDATION METRICS and a KAPSO_EVAL_MANIFEST line containing the primary score, item count, fidelity, and archived run.

The seeded candidate is intentionally trivial: recommendation predictions are always the first K IDs, classification predictions are constants or uniform scores, and regression predictions are the training median; it is explicitly intended to be replaced.

evidence.description: Identifies the file as a baseline candidate
Directs the user to replace the baseline

claims.statement: In rolling ticks, an empty or missing val.parquet makes main.py set rolling=True, skip val_predictions.npy, and write only that tick's test predictions; the rolling grader later assembles the official vectors.

evidence.description: Documents empty validation tables in rolling snapshots
Uses zero validation rows when the cache file is absent
Marks zero validation rows as rolling
Skips validation output in rolling mode
Requires test predictions for each rolling tick

claims.statement: The grader passes --debug for fast fidelity, but the seeded main.py only reports whether the flag was present and does not otherwise change its computation, so real solutions must implement their own cheap debug path.

evidence.description: Uses --debug only in the printed debug field

claims.statement: The local recommendation checker warns about out-of-range or duplicate IDs instead of failing, even though such predictions will not satisfy the intended destination-ID ranking contract.

evidence.description: Reports out-of-range IDs as a warning

claims.statement: The candidate depends on NumPy for prediction arrays and on RelBench for task types and task loading.

evidence.description: States the suite requires relbench and numpy

claims.statement: The baseline candidate requires RELBENCH_DATASET, RELBENCH_TASK, RELBENCH_CACHE_DIR, and KAPSO_RUN_DATA_DIR in its runtime environment.
The evaluation environment also supplies the primary metric, work/archive directory, debug/full timeouts, sanitized cache, and shared candidate cache through environment variables.

evidence.description: Documents work directory and timeout variables
